notes_for_editor: Weakest of the three. Only the FFLA listing, the OSM node and the Forest Lookouts list name the tower; no map or newspaper source found. The Pastmaps Marinette County 1970s pages do not name a Peshtigo lookout. AnyPlaceAmerica returned 403. The 1871 fire is cited only to separate the name from the tower; no source ties the tower to it. FFLA (45.08833, -87.75731) and OSM (45.0885952, -87.7562171) coordinates differ by roughly 100 m, which is worth a check before any map use. The DNR paragraph is statewide background only. A Wisconsin Historical Society Facebook post on towers did not open; it describes a tower moved by the CCC in 1935, which is not checked against these three.
